Also, verify if the ceiling structure physically connects to the walls correctly or if it appears to float/hang impossibly. The pipes have a golden/brass finish with decorative finials on top. The organ is mounted against a white wall with wooden side panels and green acoustic padding visible on the far left and right. Above the organ, a wooden ceiling structure with a central carved wooden boss or bracket is visible.

To confirm the specific type of organ and verify it matches the 'organ' class label with high confidence.
